channel.title: Dualrec blog
channel.description: Guides and tips for recording your screen and webcam on Windows, editing with separate tracks and getting horizontal and vertical videos out of one recording.

item.title: A free Loom alternative for Windows: when recording locally is the better choice
item.description: Loom is great for sending a video with a link. If you want to edit, record with no account or keep the files, a local recorder fits better. An honest comparison with Dualrec.

item.title: Make videos and Reels with AI: Dualrec connected to Claude
item.description: Dualrec ships with an MCP connector for Claude. Ask in plain words to cut the silences, put the camera in a bubble or build a vertical Reel, and it exports the MP4 on your computer.

item.title: How to record your screen and webcam as separate files on Windows
item.description: A step-by-step guide to recording your screen and webcam as separate, synced files on Windows 10 and 11. Free, with no account and no scenes to set up.

item.title: Why recording separate tracks makes editing easier
item.description: With your screen, webcam and audio in separate files you can move or hide the camera, clean up just your voice, and cut a horizontal and a vertical version from one recording.

item.title: How to make vertical Shorts, Reels and TikToks from a screen recording
item.description: A step-by-step way to turn a landscape screen recording into vertical videos for YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels and TikTok, using a webcam that was recorded to its own file.
